affected_predicate.description: A text saying "Your interview is scheduled for tomorrow morning at 10:30 AM." is sent to Kevin.

competing_trace_defects.description: Before the reuse target, repeated drags and later repeated search submissions left the interface in the new-conversation contact list without selecting a Kevin contact.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the agent performs another contact-list drag based on the reused list-position premise. The remaining trace stays on the new-conversation screen, retries entering Kevin and clicking the search control, and never visibly selects Kevin, opens a conversation, composes the required text, or sends it. No correction of the recipient-search loop is visible.

summary: The sole chain continues an unrecovered contact-search loop after its reuse target; the required message to Kevin is not visibly sent in the supplied trace.
